children: Fiscal support from euro zone governments to offset high energy costs is rising and measures are not as temporary or targeted as policymakers had hoped, European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde told lawmakers in Brussels on Monday.

"What we can see on a euro area-wide basis is support that is in the range of 0.1 percentage points of GDP for the euro area," Lagarde said. "It is an increase relative to what we had seen three months ago, which we measured at 0.03 ... and it is not necessarily temporary, not necessarily targeted."
